## Release — backlog-campaign v0.33.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.33.0

#### Sleep mode is retired

Since v0.32.0 parks owner decisions by default, sleep mode only bundled four unrelated behaviours. Each now lives where it belongs (ADR-059 amendment, [#1433](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1433), [#1434](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1434)).

- **Keep-awake follows the run.** `run` and `catchup` hold the machine awake while a worker is in flight or a wake is armed, and let it sleep again at drain, stop and `STOP-CAMPAIGN`. Whether you are at the desk no longer matters. A PR waiting on CI does not count as a worker in flight.
- **Unattended starts pass `--unattended`.** The scheduled catchup passes it, and its launch gate then prints the summary without asking. The flag applies to one invocation only and is never stored, so an interactive start always asks.
- **`/blackhole decide` reports what ran since the last round.** It lists issues finished, open PRs with their blockers, and weekly points used, measured from the previous decide round. The first round says "not measured".
- **`/blackhole sleep` and `/blackhole wake` are gone.** Each prints a line naming its replacement.

#### Slash-command hint

- The `/blackhole` argument hint now lists every mode: `run`, `catchup`, `status`, `decide`, `stop`, `handle`, `plan`, `implement`, `review`, `hunt` and `campaign-audit`. A verify check keeps the hint and the Modes table in sync ([#1432](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1432)).

### Migration for existing campaigns

| Campaign state | After upgrading | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `config.json` still has a `sleep_mode` block | Ignored with a warning (run context, launch summary, Run panel, decide report); never an error | Delete the `sleep_mode` block |
| Away at upgrade time (`sleep_mode.since` set) | The first `decide` uses that sleep baseline once, so the away report is kept | None |
| A keep-awake hold taken by `sleep --on` | Picked up from the old record and released at the next drain or stop | None |
| Scheduled catchup task whose prompt says "turn sleep mode on" | `sleep` now fails, and without `--unattended` the launch gate asks | Use the prompt in `phase-catchup.md` § Scheduled task: `/blackhole catchup --unattended --usage-file <file>` |
| `decisions.mode: "ask"` | Gates ask as they come; nothing parks them while you are away | Keep the default `park` for unattended runs |
| Status JSON readers | Run panel field `sleep_mode` becomes `retired_sleep_mode`; `run-context.json` records `keep_awake` instead of `sleep_mode` | Update the reader |

### Upgrade

The plugin cache is version-keyed. Run `/plugin marketplace update blackhole-marketplace`, then reinstall the plugin, and restart Claude Code. A running session keeps its installed version until it restarts.
